limitations: The numerical code behind the source figures is unavailable; no assertion of exact reproduction of figures is made.
Complex continuation is not a physical trace-preserving channel beyond the boundary.
No claim concerns global reservoir coupling or initially NPT cases.
scientific_integrity: The result is an exact algebraic analysis of a published six-Kraus model, not a reconstruction of its numerical figures. The known theorem that local CP operations preserve PPT is supporting background; the sharp model-specific cutoff and trace-defect formula are the contribution.
title: Exact trace-preservation boundary and spurious two-qutrit entanglement signal
